## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Security-audit gating failure |
| 2 | Invalid input or validation failure |
| 3 | Violations found (apply) or diagnostics found (diagnose) |
| 4 | Internal error |
| 130 | Interrupted (SIGINT) |
